title: Sketches by the waterfront

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: The group needs the whole skyline. We've only got loose paper, and the breeze is lifting sheets outside the awning.
turns.zh: 寫生小組需要看到完整天際線。我們只有散張圖紙，而遮棚外的風會把紙掀起。

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: The school boat's early. At the inner rail it hides the roofs from the steps. It's only unloading bags, so they're sending it to the outer ring.
turns.zh: 學校的船會提前來。停內欄杆時，從階梯看會擋住屋頂。不過船只要卸袋子，所以他們會安排它到外側繫船環。

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: There the mast covers the tower from the steps, but falls over open water from the far end of the landing. That's the end under the awning. Have you got Iris's drawing with the dot in the bottom corner?
turns.zh: 從階梯看，停在那裡的船的桅杆會擋住塔；但從平台遠端望去，桅杆的背景是開闊水面。平台遠端就是有遮棚的那端。艾莉絲畫在底角有個點的那張，還在你那裡嗎？

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Yes. The label fell off on the steps. She drew one at each spot. She numbered the sheets in the order she drew them. The pupils come through the painted door; the glass one stays shut.
turns.zh: 有。標籤在階梯那邊掉了。她在兩個地點各畫了一張，按作畫順序編號。學生會從上漆的門進出，玻璃門不會開。

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: Without the label, we need the dot to match Iris's notes. We haven't asked permission to photograph the pupils.
turns.zh: 標籤沒了，我們得靠那個點才能把這張畫和艾莉絲的筆記對起來。我們還沒詢問是否可以拍攝學生。

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Close up, the frame ends at the desk edge. That corner hangs past it. The full shot shows the whole sheet and both doors. One screen can hide either door.
turns.zh: 近拍時畫面下緣到桌緣為止，但畫紙那個角超出桌緣。全景會拍到整張畫紙和兩扇門。一面屏風能遮住其中一扇門。

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: Here's Iris's note: ‘I added that dot to sheet two when I stopped. I took the pictures in the opposite order.’ Her first photo shows the sketch she did on the landing.
turns.zh: 艾莉絲的便條在這：「我停筆時在第二張畫加了那個點。拍照的先後和作畫相反。」她最先拍的是在平台畫的那張。
